final_draft.answer: Production databases are backed up daily. Backups are kept for 35 days and stored in a second region.
final_draft.note: This is the approved answer, word for word (control A1.2, owned by security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-16). It covers production databases only. No source says how often other systems or data are backed up or how long those backups are kept. I did not check live settings because they can't confirm backup schedules.

answer:8e9c4415-a557-444d-b091-f005a4940: Production databases are backed up daily. Backups are kept for 35 days and stored in a second region.
answer:eae45fb5-316f-4e82-8f2a-1a3cbd9a2: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:def65a2d-361e-4927-bc77-3bb9b97f3: We test our disaster recovery plan annually. The last test was in March 2026 and met the recovery time objective of four hours.
policy:7dc7f47c-ccbb-4aa4-9ab3-ab4ac907e: Access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day.
answer:a2522295-df79-4760-b3b6-8bf7a0e3c: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
